family: finite disjoint products of genuine Boolean point defects q_n

tree.stage_rule: exhaust the current point-defect block before moving to the next block

shape_proof.consequence: the secant slope is first nondecreasing and then nonincreasing

single_use.complete_bound: R(A)+sum_j N_j<24 sum_j I(q_{n_j})=24 I(product_j q_{n_j})

scope.near_tensors: all finite disjoint products of the declared point-defect factors
scope.prime_gates: each factor is an AND/OR-type prime gate up to signs and input relabeling
scope.rare_activation: a fresh activation multiplies reached conditional terms by its reach probability; its separate control packet is not silently charged here

remaining_obligation: Find an analogous bounded-variation or nonlocal information ledger for unrelated branching leaves and shared-variable trees, with whole-set addressing as a mandatory falsifier.
